About the Project

Cambridge's CREATES NERC doctoral funding supports environmental research through eligible courses and projects. The funding deadline depends on the course, so applicants need to match the proposed research to the correct admission route before submitting.

  • Climate research

About University of Cambridge

Cambridge offers research degrees through its departments and colleges. Doctoral training programmes in sensors, environmental science and cardiovascular research have their own selection and funding arrangements alongside university admission.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: Course-specific: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
